The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Multiple cells in the range H46:L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -2.7657, got #NAME?). This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax in the statistics block.
